license_required.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice certified public accountancy in the State.

name.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Public Accountancy.

type.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Public Accountancy.

age_minimum.quote: The applicant shall be at least 18 years old.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant shall be of good character and reputation.

degree_required.quote: an applicant shall have satisfactorily completed 150 semester hours or their equivalent, including the attainment of a baccalaureate or higher degree that meets the requirements of this section.

required.quote: The applicant for an initial license shall complete practical work experience that is approved by the Board

duration.value: 2,000 hours over not less than 1 year and not more than 3 years (for applicants on or after October 1, 2000)
duration.quote: amounts to: 2,000 hours if the applicant applies on or after October 1, 2000.

kind.value: practical work experience in accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting
kind.quote: includes providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination (AICPA)
exams.notes: Board shall give the examination prepared by the AICPA or an equivalent examination as determined by the Board.
exams.quote: The Board shall give the examination prepared by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or an equivalent examination as determined by the Board.

interval_years.quote: the licensee periodically may renew it for an additional 2–year term

required.quote: The Board shall adopt regulations that set, in accordance with this section, continuing education requirements as a condition to the renewal of licenses under this subtitle.

hours_per_period.quote: a licensee shall complete, for each 2–year license term, at least 80 hours in programs that the Board approves.

period_years.quote: for each 2–year license term, at least 80 hours in programs that the Board approves.

available.quote: the Board may waive any examination requirement of this subtitle for: a certified public accountant licensed by another state

requirements.value: Applicant must be of good character, at least 18, pay fees, and provide evidence of substantially equivalent education, examination, and experience requirements; or have passed the Uniform CPA Exam and obtained 4 years of practical work experience within the last 10 years.
requirements.quote: provides adequate evidence that the applicant has met educational, examination, and experience requirements that are: substantially equivalent to those required by the laws of this State

regulatory_model.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice certified public accountancy in the State.

credential_type.quote: "License" means, unless the context requires otherwise, a license issued by the Board to practice certified public accountancy.

is_mandatory.quote: a person may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice certified public accountancy in the State unless licensed by the Board or qualified for a practice privilege under § 2–321 of this title.

title_protection.quote: unless authorized under this title to practice certified public accountancy, a person may not represent to the public, by use of a title, including "licensed certified public accountant", "certified public accountant", "public accountant", or "auditor", by use of the abbreviation "CPA"

scope_protection.quote: a person may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice certified public accountancy in the State unless licensed by the Board or qualified for a practice privilege under § 2–321 of this title.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: a misdemeanor that is directly related to the fitness and qualification of the applicant or licensee to practice certified public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.quote: has had the right to practice as a certified public accountant before any unit of the State or federal government revoked or suspended

disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been sanctioned by any unit of State or federal government, or any regulatory entity established by law, for an act or omission that directly relates to the fitness of the applicant or licensee to practice public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violates a rule of professional conduct adopted by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violates a rule of professional conduct adopted by the Board.

definition_quote.value: "Practice certified public accountancy" means to perform any of the following accountancy services: (1) conducting an audit, review, or compilation of financial statements; (2) conducting any examination, review, or agreed–upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements issued by AICPA; or (3) providing a written certificate or opinion offering positive or negative assurance or full or limited assurance on the correctness of the information or on the fairness of the presentation of the information in: a financial statement; a report; a schedule; or an exhibit.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice certified public accountancy" means to perform any of the following accountancy services: (1) conducting an audit, review, or compilation of financial statements

attest_services_types.quote: "Attest" means to provide the following services: an audit or other engagement performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards issued by AICPA; a review of a financial statement performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services issued by AICPA; a compilation; any examination, review, or agreed–upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements issued by AICPA; and any engagement performed in accordance with the Auditing Standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means a presentation of information in the form of a financial statement that is performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services issued by AICPA.

education_semester_hours_required.quote: an applicant shall have satisfactorily completed 150 semester hours or their equivalent, including the attainment of a baccalaureate or higher degree

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: In order to take the examination, an applicant shall have satisfactorily completed 120 semester hours or their equivalent

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: without any notice, fee, or other submission to the Board.

complying with State public accountancy laws and regulations adopted by the Board
appointment of the State Board of Public Accountancy that issued the individual's license as agent for service of process

practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: As a condition of the practice privilege, an individual who is licensed by another state and qualifies for a practice privilege under this subtitle and any firm that employs the individual to practice in the State shall both consent to: the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the Board; complying with State public accountancy laws and regulations adopted by the Board; the appointment of the State Board of Public Accountancy that issued the individual's license to practice certified public accountancy as the agent upon which process may be served in any action or proceeding by the Board against the individual; and ceasing to offer or provide services in the State that are subject to this title if the license issued by the state in which the individual's principal place of business is located is no longer valid.

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: A sole practitioner who is practicing in the State under the practice privilege may only perform attest services as defined in § 2–101(c)(1), (4), or (5) of this title, through a firm that holds a permit issued under § 2–401 of this title.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: have at least a simple majority of the partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers, in terms of financial interest and voting rights, be licensed in a state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: An individual who is not licensed to practice certified public accountancy in this State or another state may have an ownership interest in the partnership if: a simple majority of the ownership of the partnership, in terms of financial interests and voting rights, is held by individuals licensed to practice certified public accountancy in this or another state

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: A licensee or permit holder who performs any of the services described in § 2-4A-04 of this subtitle shall be required to undergo, at least once every 3 years, a peer review.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: shall be required to undergo, at least once every 3 years, a peer review.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The Board shall place a licensee on inactive status and issue an inactive status certificate to the licensee

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm that does not have an office in this State may perform attest services as defined in § 2–101(c) of this title for a client in this State without a permit

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: Unless the client to whom an accountant's document relates and the accountant expressly agree to the contrary, the accountant's document is: the property of the accountant who prepared it; or if the accountant is a partner or employee of an accounting firm, the property of the firm.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: The Board shall adopt regulations that specify the language of the disclosure statement relating to exemption from peer review that is required to be included in a compilation of a financial statement prepared under subsection (a)(3)(iii)2 of this section.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: the holder of a license, certificate, or degree that is issued by another country and is recognized as authority for the holder to practice public accountancy in that country in a manner comparable to practicing certified public accountancy in this State.

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence of a single representation described in paragraph (1) of this subsection is, without evidence of a general course of conduct, adequate to justify a finding that a person has represented to the public that the person is authorized to practice certified public accountancy in the State.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm shall hold a permit issued by the Board if the firm: has an office in this State that performs attest services as defined in § 2–101(c) of this title
